summary: CWE-615 (Information Exposure Through Comments): the bad() method writes an HTML comment containing database credentials (`DB username = joe, DB password = 123`) into the servlet response, leaking sensitive information to anyone who views the page source. The fix removes the credential-bearing comment while preserving the login form that is the actual feature.
